evidence_summary: Replay HTTP log contradicts the claimed double-success: rename src->dst returns HTTP 200 with code=65535 'duplicated new collection name...' (REQ 5/11) while only the subsequent create(dst) succeeds code=0 (REQ 6/12), and the capture is sequential, not concurrent.
rationale: The claimed state violation (rename and create(dst) both returning code=0 in a race) is never observed - rename failed with an application error in both repetitions and no concurrency was exercised - so there is no reproducible evidence of the claimed defect (PASSED with no FAILED -> not_defect grade D score 0); the developer-cognition supplement (issue 50192) additionally marks concurrent rename+create both-success as by-design idempotent tolerance, which would defeat the claim even if it were reproduced.
